'''Alexander Freeman''' (1838&ndash;1897) was an English astronomer and [[mathematician]]<ref name=ODNB>{{cite ODNB |last=Hutchins |first=Roger |contribution=Freeman, Alexander (1838–1897) |title=Oxford Dictionary of National Biography |year=2004 |edition=online |doi=10.1093/ref:odnb/57906 |url=http://www.oxforddnb.com/view/article/57906 |accessdate=20 August 2010}} {{subscription required}}</ref> and a noted correspondent of [[James Clerk Maxwell]] and [[Willard Gibbs]].
